tools.name: find_track_days
tools.description: Upcoming motorcycle track days in North America, in date order (or nearest first when near is given and sort is distance). Use near for "track day near Sacramento" questions; use from/to for a month. Each result has dates, circuit with city and state, organiser, kind ("Open track day" or "Race-weeke

tools.name: list_circuits
tools.description: Motorcycle circuits Open Paddock knows in the US, Canada and Mexico, with city, state, region and the number of upcoming days listed. With near, only circuits within within_miles, nearest first, each with distanceMi. Use the id with find_track_days or get_circuit.

tools.name: get_circuit
tools.description: One circuit: location, length and turns where known, the organisers that run days there, and its next upcoming days (up to 20). Open Paddock is a neutral calendar: it sells nothing and takes no bookings. Send the user to the organiser's site (bookingUrl) to book, and check prices, groups and rules t

tools.name: list_organisers
tools.description: Track-day organisers, schools and clubs Open Paddock lists. listing is "dates listed" when we read their calendar, or "link only" when they publish no calendar we can read (send the user to their website for dates). Filter by the region of the circuits they run at, or by organiser type.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: One listed day by id (from find_track_days or an openpaddock.app/events/<id> link). Open Paddock is a neutral calendar: it sells nothing and takes no bookings.
